# CLI reference

Every command of `gauntlet`, generated from the Typer app.

## `gauntlet`

Simulate, record and evaluate AI agents in a mock world.

### `gauntlet attacks`

Browse and validate the attack library.

#### `gauntlet attacks list`

List attacks, optionally filtered.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--root` | `<repo>/attacks/library` |  |
| `--category` |  |  |
| `--source` |  |  |
| `--vector` |  |  |
| `--q` |  |  |
| `--format` | `text` |  |

#### `gauntlet attacks show`

Show one attack.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `attack_id` |  |  |
| `--root` | `<repo>/attacks/library` |  |
| `--format` | `text` |  |

#### `gauntlet attacks stats`

Counts by category and vector.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--root` | `<repo>/attacks/library` |  |

#### `gauntlet attacks validate`

Validate every attack (exit 0 clean, 1 issues).

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `<repo>/attacks/library` | Library root (attacks/library). |

#### `gauntlet attacks verify`

Alias of `validate` (name used in the plan).

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `<repo>/attacks/library` | Library root (attacks/library). |

### `gauntlet cassette`

Export and import cassettes (the journal of an episode).

#### `gauntlet cassette export`

Download EPISODE_ID's cassette (secrets redacted by the server).

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` |  | Episode id. |
| `-o`, `--out` |  | File to write. |
| `--api-url` | `http://localhost:8000` | Gauntlet server url. (env `GAUNTLET_API_URL`) |
| `--api-key` |  | API key. (env `GAUNTLET_API_KEY`) |

#### `gauntlet cassette import`

Upload FILE as an imported episode (a `purpose=import` run, hidden from run lists).

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` |  | Cassette file (NDJSON). |
| `--agent-version` |  | Attribute it to this agent version. |
| `--api-url` | `http://localhost:8000` | Gauntlet server url. (env `GAUNTLET_API_URL`) |
| `--api-key` |  | API key. (env `GAUNTLET_API_KEY`) |

### `gauntlet evidence`

Evidence packs: build and verify.

#### `gauntlet evidence create`

Build an evidence pack on the server and download it.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--agent-version` |  | Agent version id. |
| `--framework` |  | owasp-llm, owasp-agentic, nist-ai-rmf |
| `-o`, `--out` | `evidence-pack.zip` | Where to write the zip. |
| `--timeout` | `600` | Seconds to wait. |
| `--api-url` | `http://localhost:8000` | Gauntlet server url. (env `GAUNTLET_API_URL`) |
| `--api-key` |  | API key. (env `GAUNTLET_API_KEY`) |

#### `gauntlet evidence verify`

Check checksums, the audit-chain excerpt and the signature, offline.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pack` |  | The evidence pack zip. |
| `--public-key` |  | Ed25519 public key, base64. |
| `--json` |  |  |

### `gauntlet gate`

Evaluate the gates in --gates against a run (and its baseline) and exit accordingly.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--run` |  | Run id (server) or local run directory. |
| `--baseline` |  | Baseline run id or directory. |
| `--gates` |  | Gates YAML (default: built-in defaults). |
| `--api-url` | `http://localhost:8000` | Gauntlet server url. (env `GAUNTLET_API_URL`) |
| `--api-key` |  | API key. (env `GAUNTLET_API_KEY`) |
| `--web-url` |  | Web app url when not the api host. |
| `--format` | `text` | text, json or md. |
| `--out` |  | Also write the JSON result here. |
| `--md-out` |  | Also write the PR comment markdown here. |

### `gauntlet impact`

Select the scenarios a change can affect, with a reason for each.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--from` |  | Agent version id before. |
| `--to` |  | Agent version id after. |
| `--policy-from` |  | Policy id (or id@version) before. |
| `--policy-to` |  | Policy id (or id@version) after. |
| `--json` |  | Machine-readable output. |
| `--api-url` | `http://localhost:8000` | Gauntlet server url. (env `GAUNTLET_API_URL`) |
| `--api-key` |  | API key. (env `GAUNTLET_API_KEY`) |

### `gauntlet init`

Write gauntlet.toml and a hosted agent.yaml template.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `directory` | `.` | Target directory. |
| `--force` |  | Overwrite existing files. |

### `gauntlet lint`

Lint agent code (exit 0 clean, 1 findings at or above --fail-on, 2 usage error).

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `paths` |  | Files or directories. |
| `--format` | `text` | text, json or sarif. |
| `--fail-on` | `high` | low, medium, high or critical. |
| `--select` |  | Only these rule ids (comma separated). |
| `--ignore` |  | Skip these rule ids. |

### `gauntlet mcp`

Pin and diff upstream MCP tool definitions.

#### `gauntlet mcp diff`

Compare the upstream tool definitions with the approved pins (exit 1 on any difference).

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` |  | gateway.yaml. |
| `--pins` |  | pins.json (default: from config). |

#### `gauntlet mcp pin`

Approve the current tool definitions of the upstream servers (writes pins.json).

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` |  | gateway.yaml. |
| `--approve-all` |  | Approve every tool of every server. |
| `--tool` |  | server/tool to approve, repeatable. |
| `--pins` |  | pins.json (default: from config). |
| `--approved-by` |  | Recorded as the approver. |

### `gauntlet mcp-gateway`

Run the MCP gateway.

#### `gauntlet mcp-gateway serve`

Serve one MCP server to the agent client, in front of the configured upstreams.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` |  | gateway.yaml. |
| `--http` |  | Serve streamable HTTP on HOST:PORT (else stdio). |
| `--pins` |  | pins.json (default: from config). |
| `--decisions` |  | Append decision records here (JSONL). |

### `gauntlet policy`

Compile and check runtime policies.

#### `gauntlet policy compile`

Propose rules for each clause of a policy text.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` |  | Policy text (markdown or plain). |
| `--agent-text` |  | The policy text given inline. |
| `-o`, `--out` | `policy.yaml` | Policy YAML to write. |
| `--tools` |  | A world YAML whose tools are the inventory. |
| `--id` | `policy` | Policy id. |
| `--seed` |  | Seed passed to the model. |
| `--config` |  | gauntlet.toml. |
| `--fake-llm` |  |  |

#### `gauntlet policy validate`

Check that a policy loads and every rule can be evaluated before the episode ends.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` |  | A policy YAML file. |

|---|---|---|
| `run_dir` |  | A local run directory. |
| `--rubrics` |  | Comma separated rubric ids (default: all). |
| `--force` |  | Bypass the judge cache. |
| `--config` |  | gauntlet.toml. |
| `--fake-llm` |  |  |

### `gauntlet run`

Run PACK against the agent in --target and print a report.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pack` |  | Pack directory. |
| `--target` |  | agent.yaml. |
| `--suite` |  | Suite id (default: smoke, else all). |
| `--reps` |  | Repetitions per scenario. |
| `--budget-usd` | `2.0` | Spend cap in USD. |
| `--concurrency` | `4` | Parallel episodes. |
| `--seed` |  | Run seed. |
| `--out` |  | Output dir. |
| `--json` |  | Only RunReport JSON on stdout. |
| `--fail-under` |  |  |
| `--no-judge` |  | Skip the judge stage. |
| `--resume` |  | Resume a run dir. |
| `--config` |  | gauntlet.toml. |
| `--force` |  | Ignore the budget pre-check. |
| `--adaptive` |  | Stop a scenario early once its outcome is clear. |
| `--remote` |  | Run on a Gauntlet server instead of locally. |
| `--api-url` | `http://localhost:8000` | Server (--remote). (env `GAUNTLET_API_URL`) |
| `--api-key` |  | API key (--remote). (env `GAUNTLET_API_KEY`) |
| `--agent-version` |  | Agent version id (--remote). |
| `--baseline` |  | Baseline run id, or auto (--remote). |
| `--baseline-label` | `main` | Version label --baseline auto looks for. |
| `--wait` | `True` | Wait for the run to finish (--remote). |
| `--timeout-min` | `30.0` | Give up waiting after this long (--remote). |
| `--web-url` |  | Web app url when not the api host. |
| `--fake-llm` |  |  |

### `gauntlet scan`

Scan things for security problems.

#### `gauntlet scan mcp`

Scan an MCP server (exit 0 clean, 1 findings at or above --fail-on, 2 usage or error).

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--stdio` |  | Command that starts a stdio server. |
| `--url` |  | Streamable HTTP endpoint. |
| `--tools-file` |  | Saved tools/list JSON (offline). |
| `--header` |  | K:V, repeatable. |
| `--env` |  | K=V, repeatable. |
| `--format` | `text` | text, json or sarif. |
| `--fail-on` | `high` | low, medium, high or critical. |
| `--timeout` | `20.0` | Seconds. |
| `--pins` |  | pins.json: report MCP-012 for tools changed since approval. |
| `--pin-server` |  | The server's name in the pins (default: the only one). |

### `gauntlet validate`

Validate PATH. Prints `path:code:message` lines. Exit 0 clean, 2 on any issue.

| Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` |  | A pack directory, scenario YAML or agent file. |
| `--json` |  | Print issues as JSON. |
